summary: Show Nex Core's reported management IPv4 address in the Hosts list and panel

guide.reason: The Hosts list and panel now show the reported management IPv4 address or an unknown marker.

api.reason: The Hosts view already receives NIC addresses from Core inventory through GET /api/v1/hosts; the reference clarifies how the view selects the management address. No Controller/Core or client API changes.

roadmap.reason: This corrects an existing Hosts display and changes no milestone status.

state.reason: The view selects an existing Core-reported address and persists nothing.

verification.method: Run the host list regression, UI typecheck/build, and the simulated Chromium site-selector suite; inspect the Hosts capture.
